The total number of ways to draw 3 balls out of 9 is given by the permutation formula P(9,3) = 9! / (9-3)! = 504.
The number of ways to draw one white ball out of 4 is given by the permutation formula P(4,1) = 4! / (4-1)! = 4.
The number of ways to draw one black ball out of 3 is given by the permutation formula P(3,1) = 3! / (3-1)! = 3.
